newsitem.title: USA: Not sure if U.S. economy growing too fast--Rivlin.
newsitem.headline: Not sure if U.S. economy growing too fast--Rivlin.

text.p: Federal Reserve Vice Chairwoman Alice Rivlin on Thursday said she was not certain if the U.S. economy was growing at a higher-than-sustainable rate.
"That's what we're not sure of," Rivlin told reporters in response to a question about whether the economy was "perking along" at a sustainable pace.
She further added that the Fed had "no magic number" for a target gross domestic product growth rate.
Concerning the current economic picture, she said, "We have to look to see what is happening in the economy, how all the pieces fit together."
Rivlin spoke with reporters after addressing a conference of the National Community Reinvestment Coalition.
